title: Bourgeon - Location, Weakness & Rewards
description: Bourgeon in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - where to find it, its elemental weakness and resistances, and how to beat it.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: Flying Waters, Stone Wave Cliffs, The Continent

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Bourgeon is a recurring flower-bodied Nevron boss that appears in three separate places across Act 1 and Act 2. Fire is the answer every time, and defeating the Flying Waters instance is how you obtain Abysseram.

sections.title: Where to Find the Bourgeon
sections.content:
Location: Flying Waters, Stone Wave Cliffs, The Continent.

Availability: Act 1.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances
sections.content:
PropertyValue
Weak toFire

Bring Fire damage. Nothing else in its profile resists damage, so any other element is merely unremarkable rather than wasted.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.content:
• Colour of Lumina
  • Chroma Catalyst
  • Pictos or weapon tied to the encounter

Exact drop quantities for this encounter are not documented in the sources we could verify, so they are not listed rather than estimated.

sections.title: How to Beat the Bourgeon
sections.content:
What actually kills you

Chromatic variants hit harder and hold more health than the enemy they are based on. The failure mode is almost always running out of resources mid-fight rather than a mechanic you did not understand, so bring healing headroom rather than a greedier damage build.
